title: CNT critical radius and free-energy barrier computation
action: Using classical nucleation theory (CNT): r* = 2γV_m/(RT ln S) and ΔG = 4πr*²γ - (4/3)πr*³ (RT ln S/V_m). Given parameters: γ = 0.3 J m⁻², V_m = 8.0×10⁻⁶ m³ mol⁻¹, S = 10, R = 8.314 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹. Compute r* (converted to nm) and ΔG (in J) at T = 673 K and T = 923 K. Write the four numerical values as a JSON object.
description: Scored artifact containing the computed critical radius (nm) and critical excess free energy (J) at the two nucleation temperatures.
output_schema: object with keys: r_star_673K (float, nm), deltaG_star_673K (float, J), r_star_923K (float, nm), deltaG_star_923K (float, J)
